messages.subject: Multiple Outputs from reactiveFunction
parts:
This is a follow up to a question that was partially answered a few days ago

server.R

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  data <- reactive(function() {

  processing to obtain initial dataset

  some processing produces data.frame, df1

  more processing produces data.frame, df2

 return???

})

output$plot1 <- reactivePlot(function() {
    
       plot based on df1
        
  })

output$plot1 <- reactivePlot(function() {
    
       plot based on df2
        
  })

})

If there is just one  data.frame df1 produced  and it is returned from the data function  then i can use data() as the input for the plot NB df1 is not equivalent to data().using it causes an Object not found error
But how do I handle multiple data.frames in the data function and subsequently refer to  them in plot functions? Or is the , less attractive , alternative to have a
 data function which produces the initial dataset and then have separate data functions to produce each of the df1, df2 etc. which uses that data() as input?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Multiple Outputs from reactiveFunction
parts:
The "less attractive alternative" is what I had in mind when I designed the framework. Another option would be to just have one function as you do now, but return:

list(df1=df1, df2=df2)

then refer to data()$df1, data()$df2 in your other functions.
